title: The viewer's Viewer struct holds 35 fields across five concerns
body:
`Viewer` in `viewer.rs` has 35 fields. `Keys` and `Clipboard` are already split out. Pointer state is eight loose fields (`pointer`, `cursor_shape`, `shape_device`, `enter_serial`, `pointer_time`, `cursor`, `scroll`, `scroll_source`), frame state three (`buffers`, `pending`, `shown`) and handshake state four (`configured`, `formats`, `sent`, `welcomed`). `pointer_event` is 78 lines, 40 of them scroll accumulation. In `dmabuf_feedback`, `match (&self.sent, self.formats.clone())` always sees `Some` formats and reduces to `if self.sent.is_some() { .. } else { self.hello() }`.

`inhibit.rs` is a 36-line module with one caller. `Shortcuts::set<D: Dispatch<Inhibitor, ()>>` has one instantiation, and its `(true, Some(i)) => self.inhibitor = Some(i)` arm puts back what `take()` removed.

## Proposal

A `Pointer` struct like `Keys`, with a `scroll_event` method, and a `Frames` struct. The inhibitor becomes two fields and a six-line method on `Viewer`.
